name: scrapa
description: Read web pages as markdown, search the web, list a site's URLs and run a real Chrome.

interface.shortDescription: Web pages, search and a real Chrome
interface.longDescription: scrapa reads a web page and hands it back as markdown, HTML, text, links, a screenshot or a PDF, with a plain HTTP request or a real Chrome, whichever the page needs. It also searches the web, lists every URL a site publishes, reads a long list of pages in the background, and holds a browser your own Playwright or Puppeteer code can drive. Every answer says what it cost. A page the site blocked costs nothing, unless a script you sent ran in it first.
capabilities: Read a web page as markdown, text or a screenshot
Search the web and read the results
List a site's URLs and read many pages at once
Hold a real Chrome for your own scripts
defaultPrompt: Search the web for this week's news about electric buses in Brazil.
List the blog URLs on example.com.
